rows.text: No one knows what Genius Society #77 Puzzle thought in her final moments — a genius always at odds with her desires, who stripped away her "wisdom" in the membrane space, discarding all her yesterdays and dying as an ignorant mundane. Countless scholars have attempted to break the crystal's seal to access her profound insights, only to reach a trivial conclusion — the depth of Puzzle's wisdom was as negligible as that of a wildflower blooming in her hometown.
